candidates.change_summary: Change the supportsInterface function to always return false instead of checking against known interface IDs.
Change the supportsInterface function to always return true instead of checking against known interface IDs.
Remove the check for IERC1155MetadataURI interface ID, so it only supports IERC1155.
Remove the check for IERC1155 interface ID, so it only supports IERC1155MetadataURI.
Remove super.supportsInterface call so it only checks the two ERC1155 interfaces.
Replace the balanceOf body to always return 0, causing it to return zero even when the account holds tokens.
Replace the balanceOf body to return _balances[id][account] + 1, inflating every balance by one.
Replace the balanceOf body to return a constant non-zero value for any non-zero query, making balances independent of actual holdings.
Remove the require that account != address(0), allowing zero-address queries to return a balance without reverting.
Return 0 instead of the actual balance for the given account and id.
Replace `accounts.length` with `ids.length` in the array size requirement check.
Replace `accounts.length` with `ids.length` in the loop condition.
Replace `balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[i])` with `balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[0])` inside the loop.
Replace `balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[i])` with `balanceOf(accounts[0], ids[i])` inside the loop.
Remove the `require` statement entirely (delete the line).
